landing.tagline: Build your Deen one prayer at a time.
landing.hero_desc: Deeny is the modern, calming space to track your daily prayers, build meaningful streaks, and reflect on your personal spiritual growth.
landing.available: Free forever. Works on any device.
landing.features_desc: Deeny provides a calm, gamified, and insightful environment to help you connect with your faith daily.
landing.feat_prayer_tracking_desc: Effortlessly track your 5 daily prayers. Build consistency with gentle, non-intrusive reminders.
landing.feat_streaks_desc: Stay motivated. Earn XP, level up your spiritual journey, and maintain beautiful prayer streaks.
landing.feat_heatmap_desc: Visualize your prayer habits over weeks and months with our beautiful GitHub-style heatmap.
landing.feat_quran_reader_desc: Read, listen, and search the Quran with a built-in reader. Your dedicated tab for daily recitation.
landing.feat_streak_freeze_desc: Protect your streak on missed days. Earn freeze shields every 7 days of consistency.
landing.feat_reflections_desc: Record weekly Quran reflections. Tag verses, choose categories, and build a personal wisdom timeline.
landing.feat_notifications_desc: Get gentle push notifications before each prayer time so you never miss a prayer.
landing.feat_names_desc: Learn, reflect, and memorize the beautiful names of Allah with integrated learning tools.
landing.feat_journey_desc: Weekly reports, celebration moments, streak protection, Quran reflections, and more — everything you need to grow your Deen, all in one beautiful app.
landing.how_desc: Building a habit shouldn't be stressful. Deeny guides you gently.
landing.step1_desc: Tap once to log your prayer. It's fast, beautifully animated, and deeply satisfying.
landing.step2_desc: Watch your consistency grow. Earn badges and maintain your streak to build a solid habit.
landing.step3_desc: Review weekly reports, write Quran reflections, explore the 99 Names, and celebrate your progress.
landing.preview_reflection_text: Patience and trust in Allah are essential during difficult times…
landing.review_aisha: Deeny helped me stay consistent with my prayers. The gentle reminders and the heatmap visual really motivate me on low days.
landing.review_omar: So clean and ad-free. It feels like opening a premium app designed for my faith. Exactly what I was looking for.
landing.review_fatima: The gamification aspect is perfectly balanced. It doesn't feel like a toy, it feels like a genuine tool for spiritual growth.
landing.cta_desc: Join thousands of others building consistency, peace, and mindfulness in their daily worship.
landing.prayer_tracking_desc: Track all five daily prayers with a single tap.
landing.streak_motivation_desc: Build consistency with daily streaks and achievements.
landing.monthly_calendar_desc: Visualise your prayer history in a color-coded calendar.
landing.daily_ayah_desc: Start each day with a verse from the Quran.
landing.footer: Deeny — Your daily companion for Salah.
